Plot a derivative-chromosome reconstruction

Source: R/seq_rose_derivatives.R
seq_rose_derivatives.Rd

Draws a plot_derivatives table set (schema version 1), as written by the ROSE package, with seq_block(), seq_connector(), seq_synteny(), seq_track_label() and seq_caption(). The adapter only selects, renames and maps table columns to element arguments. One track is drawn per row: a reference row, derivative rows, deleted copies and candidate strips. All rows share one base-pair scale. Clusters with cn_panels also get copy number tracks above the rows.

Usage

seq_rose_derivatives(
  x,
  fill = c("cytoband", "solid"),
  palette = NULL,
  block_colors = NULL,
  synteny = FALSE,
  label_inside = FALSE,
  flip_style = c("rotate", "overline", "minus"),
  show_loose = TRUE,
  cytobands = NULL,
  annotations = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A directory holding plot_derivatives.*.tsv files, or a list of data frames with a schema_version. See seq_read_table_set().

fill

"cytoband" (default) or "solid".

palette

NULL (default hues), "soft", or a character vector of colours, optionally named by fill_key.

block_colors

Optional named colours overriding block fills by label, then by key.

synteny

Logical. Draw ribbons between the reference and derivative rows.

label_inside

Logical. Place block labels inside blocks when they fit.

flip_style

How flipped blocks are marked: "rotate", "overline" or "minus".

show_loose

Logical. Draw the loose derivative rows and the rows that continue them.

cytobands

Cytoband table passed to seq_block(). NULL uses the bundled hg38 bands.

annotations

Optional data frame for seq_block() annotations, with an optional track column naming the row label to draw on. Rows without track go on the reference and derivative rows.

...

Arguments merged over the seq_plot() defaults.

Value

A SeqPlot, extendable with %+%.
